name: Lynching
overview: Scripture clearly affirms the sanctity of human life, emphasizing that man is made in the image of God and that shedding innocent blood is a grave offense deserving of just consequence, as stated in Genesis 9:6 and Exodus 23:7. The Lord's hatred for injustice and unrighteousness is underscored in Proverbs 6:16, highlighting the seriousness of such sins. Furthermore, Galatians 3:13 reveals that Christ bore the curse of the law, including the curse upon those who are hung on a tree, demonstrating the redemptive work of Christ in relation to the consequences of sin and judgment.
